actions.title: Supply the cyclone-shelter list for this coast
actions.summary: PRAHARI has no shelter register for Bangladesh landfall coast, so it cannot check which shelters sit in the flood or assign people to them. With a register, shelter orders appear here like they do for Odisha.

actions.title: Evacuate 618 people from the modelled flood zone
actions.summary: 618 people live in 5 flood clusters of Bangladesh landfall coast. With no shelter register, choose safe buildings outside the flood locally.

limitations: Shelter capacity is imputed from shelter type; OSDMA publishes none.
Travel distance is straight-line x 1.3 detour; no road network, so road flooding before evacuation is not modelled.
Evacuation demand is the population of modelled flood cells only; wind and rain exposure are not added to demand.
Parametric zones are illustrative, not actuarially derived.
Payout matrices are demonstrative of the mechanism only.

failure_analysis: CSI 0.000 is near zero: the predicted and observed masks barely overlap. Check the truth pipeline (orbit geometry, swath edges, date gap) before attributing this to the model.

Largest miss: Bangladesh Landfall Coast (9 km2 observed wet, modelled dry). A surge-only model cannot represent rain-fed or riverine flooding; where that is the cause it is out of scope, not a tuning target.
First post-event pass is ~30 h after landfall; surge water that drained before the pass counts as a false alarm.
DEM vertical error (~4 m) is comparable to the surge level itself; Copernicus GLO-30 is a surface model, so canopy and roofs read high.
